name: Jarvis Music Agent
description: Lightweight local-first music library, download, playback, queue, and playlist agent.

tools.name: music_status
tools.description: Inspect the local music library, queue, current track, playback state, favorites, and recent history.

scan.description: Scan the configured local library before returning status.

tools.name: music_search
tools.description: Search the local music library first by title, artist, album, filename, or close spelling match; optionally include yt-dlp remote candidates and remember them for follow-up playlist adds.

query.description: Song, artist, album, or playlist search text.

include_remote.description: Whether to ask the configured downloader for remote candidates after local search.

limit.description: Maximum local and remote matches to return.

tools.name: music_download
tools.description: Download one song with yt-dlp only when it is not already present locally; record metadata and avoid duplicate downloads. Uses the last music query when query/url is omitted in a follow-up.

query.description: Song search text to download when no local match exists.

url.description: Direct media URL from an allowed source.

tools.name: music_play
tools.description: Play or retry a song through VLC, or play a playlist. Search local files first, download with yt-dlp if allowed and not already present, then launch playback and update queue/history. Uses the last music query when query is omitted in a follow-up like play it, download it and play it, or not playing.

query.description: Song, artist, album, or close spelling match to play.

allow_download.description: Whether the tool may download when no local match exists.

tools.name: music_control
tools.description: Control music playback and queue state: pause, resume, stop, next, previous, play again, shuffle, repeat, or inspect state.

enabled.description: Repeat or shuffle setting when the operation supports it.

tools.name: music_playlist
tools.description: Create, list, delete, edit, batch-fill, or play local music playlists. Add operations resolve local tracks first, then download with yt-dlp only when allowed.

query.description: Song search text for add/remove operations.

track_id.description: Known local track id for add/remove operations.

count.description: Number of remembered or searched remote candidates to add for add_top.

allow_download.description: Whether add/add_top may download missing tracks with yt-dlp after local search.

tools.name: music_library
tools.description: Scan, list, inspect, favorite, unfavorite, or show recent local music library tracks.
